tools.name: get_rules
tools.description: Foundation rules: concrete values for motion, states, typography, spacing, surfaces, focus and anti-patterns. Pass a topic for one file; omit it for the token roles, the finished? checklist and the list of topics.

tools.name: list_components
tools.description: Every UI Polish component with a one-line summary and version. Those marked agent kit are for AI products.

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: The code and guide for one component: when and when not to use it, every state, motion specs, accessibility notes, before/after. Includes the components it depends on and the npm packages to install.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_components" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Every UI Polish template, block and component with a one-line summary and version. Templates are whole working apps (a chat app, an agent console, an agent workspace for coding); blocks are whole screens (sign-in, billing, team members, an approvals inbox, an agent task). Those marked pro need a UI " → after: "Every UI Polish component with a one-line summary and version. Those marked agent kit are for AI products."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
